areas.ag: Rhode Island Dept. of Environmental Management
areas.t: A dry cold front is working it's way through RI on Friday with a tad cooler and cleaner airmass for Halloween. Sunshine, NW winds, and highs in the mid 50s. Temps drop quickly in the evening down to freezing overnight. High pressure hangs in for Sunday, with highs in the upper 50s, light winds. Fine
